topThreats.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Friday added two security flaws impacting Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following active exploitation in the wild. topThreats.title: CISA Adds Two Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog

streamItems.remediation: Board/Executive: Review third-party digital trust and cryptographic supplier risk (SCRM). Task Execution: Inventory all TLS/code-signing certificates, verify root CA pinning, and automate certificate lifecycle rotation.

streamItems.title: Alpine Linux rebuilds GitLab after attempted RCE attack
streamItems.summary: Hackers attempted to exploit a critical GitLab vulnerability in Alpine Linux's development infrastructure on October 20-21, prompting the open-source project to rebuild its GitLab server and reset all passwords over concerns of a possible compromise. [...]
streamItems.remediation: Board/Executive: Mandate immediate emergency asset sweep for exposed interfaces. Task Execution: Apply vendor patch or emergency WAF virtual patch, audit access logs for IOCs, and restrict management ports.

streamItems.title: Synology warns of C3RB3R ransomware attacks targeting NAS devices
streamItems.summary: Taiwanese network-attached storage (NAS) appliance maker Synology warned customers to update their devices immediately due to a surge in C3RB3r ransomware attacks. [...]
streamItems.remediation: Board/Executive: Review cyber insurance limits and immutable backup posture. Task Execution: Verify offline backup isolation, enforce phishing-resistant MFA, and validate EDR coverage across all domain controllers.
